title: African Slave Trade Patrol
summary: The English Wikipedia article "African Slave Trade Patrol", at revision 1381888473, opens: "The United States' African Slave Trade Patrol was part of the Blockade of Africa suppressing the Atlantic slave trade between 1819 and the beginning of the American Civil War in 1861. Due to the abolitionist movement in the United States, a squadron of U.S. Navy warships and cutters were assigned to catch slave traders in and around Africa. In 42 years about 100 suspected slave ships were captured." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4689914, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Blockade of Africa suppressing the Atlantic slave trade". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
